abilities.name: Longboat Raid!
abilities.description: Cooldown: 90 seconds Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.  Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

abilities.name: Play Again!
abilities.description: Cooldown: 100 seconds Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds.   Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

abilities.name: Viking Hoard
abilities.description: Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.  Current Bonus: 0 Regen per second

abilities.name: Go Go Go!
abilities.description: Cooldown: 30 seconds The Vikings gain 30% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Hearthstone
abilities.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Mana.

abilities.name: Spin To Win!
abilities.description: Cooldown: 10 seconds Activate to have each Viking deal 85 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

abilities.name: Jump!
abilities.description: Cooldown: 30 seconds Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

talents.description: Passive: Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health.  Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

talents.name: Erik the Swift

talents.name: It's a Sabotage!

talents.name: Fury of the Storm
talents.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 41 (+4% per level) damage to the target, and 105 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters. Each Viking has their own cooldown.
